question: What is the “atomic shadow”?
answer: The flash hit the ground at about 4,000 °C in an instant, and people within half a kilometre were vaporized. For that instant their bodies blocked the heat, so their outline stayed printed on concrete or asphalt. That outline is the atomic shadow.
move: The shadow is the person: the only trace the flash left.

web.label: A wall with a dark human silhouette burned into it, the rest of the wall intact. The reader drags a person along the wall, then presses Flash to see the outline the heat leaves behind.

source: Geopop, “Le due bombe atomiche che hanno cambiato il mondo: la ricostruzione 3D di Little Boy e Fat Man” (YouTube, 2026)
